title: Exec signal mosaic and decision threads for inference capacity and governance
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Goal: Produce a concise executive-ready packet that synthesizes signals across capacity, latency/cost SLOs, rollout governance, and can be used in the upcoming monthly executive briefing and QBR. Deliverables: 1) 1-slide top-line "mosaic" of signals showing trajectory vs target (throughput, p95 latency, cost per 1k tokens, utilization by pool), 2) decision threads with recommended asks (reserve capacity delta, temporary burst policy, canary rollback thresholds), 3) a short runbook for governance tied to Dedicated and Private rollouts, 4) appendix with metric definitions and links to dashboards and PRs. Audience: CEO, CTO, Head of Infra, Finance partner, Sales lead for enterprise. Context: usage growth last 6 weeks shows an inflection in Dedicated pool utilization that, under current autoscale settings, pushes projected spot-burst spend 22% above plan by end of Q2. This ticket synthesizes stakeholder input and engineering constraints into a set of actionable choices to present at the exec readout. Scope: executive packet + one 30-minute dry run for execs and follow-up decision capture. Out of scope: implementing autoscale policy changes (tracked in ENG-91234).

notes_and_decision_threads: Decision thread A: Reserve additional Dedicated capacity +10% for Q2 (ask to Finance). Pros: reduces p95 latency risk and avoids costly burst. Cons: higher committed spend. Requires signoff by 2026-03-20.

Decision thread B: Tighten autoscale burst cap and enable regional failover during peak 90-120 minutes. Pros: lower committed spend; Cons: potential transient increased latencies for some customers; engineering effort ~2 wks.
Decision thread C: Approve temporary price-protection buffer for eligible enterprise customers impacted during rollout. Requires Sales + Legal review; tracked as follow-up action.
